vda5050_check — DRIVE agv op

• Data kinds: table → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.vda5050_check(order) (to call the implementation directly, import agvfleet; agvfleet.vda5050_check(order); from the registry, opsdrive.get("vda5050_check"))

• GPU: none (CPU reference implementation only)

Usage

Checks the structural rules of a VDA 5050 order (our own second (independent) implementation, separate from the official JSON schema).

Rules: required keys / node sequenceIds are consecutive even numbers from 0, edges consecutive odd numbers / number of edges = number of nodes − 1 / each edge's start and end are the preceding and following nodes / released is contiguous from the start of base (only one switch from base → horizon) / an edge's released equals that of its end node. Returns a list of violation messages (empty = pass).

Empty input (order an empty dict) returns the list of missing required keys (reason: an empty dict contains none of the required keys).
